look.S36.ambient 2: Every alarm clock shows a different time. Otto says that’s exactly the point.

look.S33.POSTA: Aloysius straightens the edge of a sheet of paper before he even looks at what’s on it.

look.S61.tree.variant1: The guard is up; the cart will go round. Simon still has to enter it in the plan.

look.S64.TONO82: Twelve-year-old Tony. Just as focused as the caretaker in 1995, only without the bunch of keys.

look.S62.RUZENA: Mrs Little behind the counter. She’s straight-talking, but with a smile.
look.S62.jar: A clean preserving jar with a lid and a rubber seal. I’ll ask Mrs Little behind the counter about it.
